LESSON: PEACE AND CONFLICT RESOLUTION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: GOVERNANCE
Topic 5.1: Peace and Conflict Resolution

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Peace and Conflict Resolution. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Peace and Conflict Resolution
2. Practise Peace and Conflict Resolution at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Peace and Conflict Resolution

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Peace and Conflict Resolution
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Peace and Conflict Resolution. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Peace and Conflict Resolution at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Peace and Conflict Resolution at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Peace and Conflict Resolution
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Peace and Conflict Resolution. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Peace and Conflict Resolution using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Peace and Conflict Resolution in the examples.
2. Explain Peace and Conflict Resolution to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Peace and Conflict Resolution.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Peace and Conflict Resolution using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Peace and Conflict Resolution important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Peace and Conflict Resolution
2. Practise Peace and Conflict Resolution at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Peace and Conflict Resolution

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
